attributes.Note: First-time HOW TO PLAY modal (4 steps). Tutorial.luau opens it once for new players off a pillar and from the rail's HELP key, scales Holder.Fit to small screens and clones Page4.TierList.TierRow per tier.

properties.Text: Every round asks for something, like "Name a fruit".
Lock in <font color="#FFC83D">Jabuticaba</font>? Press Enter again
Press Enter to check it, then Enter again to lock it in. Changed your mind? Keep typing: nothing locks until the second Enter.
Rarer answers lift your pillar higher. Then the water rises. Stay above it to win! You earn 🐚 Shells as you play.
Rarer answers dive deeper and lift your pillar higher.
Same answer as someone else? You both get half!
